items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: So, I asked Buddy to play a bit, play. Come and sit in and play. So Buddy come and sit in, so he didn't play so well at that time.

ctx.x: Oh, you were talking about the Buddy fatigue when he came in.

Buddy come in, and he hadn't heard me since I left. He hadn't heard me since I come back from Duolst. So, I asked Buddy to play a bit, play. Come and sit in and play. So Buddy come and sit in, so he didn't play so well at that time. He didn't play the effects of whiskey had really brought him down. It sounded like a different corner to play altogether. So, Manu Mineta was a very sensitive guy too. He wanted me to come back and take that horn back and play. So, I just, so I hated to do this. I had to ask Buddy,…
You want to turn it off for a minute, Lee? No, you got to turn it off for a minute. Okay. Yeah, it's going again now, Lee.
